meaning.en: an invocation, Hari Om, opening word of blessing
salutations to you, Ganapati
you alone are the reality directly in front of us
you alone are the sole doer
you alone are the sole one who sustains
you alone are the sole one who brings things to an end
you alone are truly all of this, this entire Brahman
meaning.hi: आप ही यह समस्त ब्रह्म हैं

meaning.en: you are directly the self, always
meaning.hi: आप ही साक्षात् नित्य आत्मा हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: I speak what is right, what is in tune with the true order of things
I speak the truth
may you protect me
protect the speaker
protect the listener

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: protect the giver
protect the one who upholds it
meaning.hi: धारण करने वाले की रक्षा करें

meaning.en: protect the scholar and protect the student
meaning.hi: विद्वान और शिष्य की रक्षा करें

meaning.en: protect from behind
protect from in front
protect from the north
protect from the south
protect from above
protect from below
guard me from every side, completely, all around
meaning.hi: हर ओर से, पूरी तरह मेरी रक्षा करें

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: you are made of speech, you are made of pure awareness
meaning.hi: आप वाणीमय हैं, आप चिन्मय हैं

meaning.en: you are made of bliss, you are made of Brahman
meaning.hi: आप आनंदमय हैं, आप ब्रह्ममय हैं

meaning.en: you are existence, awareness, and bliss, without a second
you are the manifest, directly present Brahman
you are made of knowledge and made of wisdom put into practice

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this entire universe is born from you
meaning.hi: यह समस्त जगत आपसे उत्पन्न होता है

meaning.en: this entire universe rests and continues because of you
meaning.hi: यह समस्त जगत आप ही में स्थित रहता है

meaning.en: this entire universe eventually dissolves back into you
meaning.hi: यह समस्त जगत अंत में आप ही में विलीन होता है

meaning.en: this entire universe rises out of you again
meaning.hi: यह समस्त जगत पुनः आप ही में प्रकट होता है

meaning.en: you are earth, water, fire, air, and space
meaning.hi: आप पृथ्वी, जल, अग्नि, वायु और आकाश हैं

meaning.en: you are the source of the four levels of speech
meaning.hi: आप वाणी के चारों पदों के ज्ञाता हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: you are beyond the three qualities of nature
meaning.hi: आप तीनों गुणों से परे हैं

meaning.en: you are beyond the three states, waking, dreaming, deep sleep
meaning.hi: आप तीनों अवस्थाओं से परे हैं

meaning.en: you are beyond the three kinds of body
meaning.hi: आप तीनों शरीरों से परे हैं

meaning.en: you are beyond the three divisions of time
meaning.hi: आप तीनों कालों से परे हैं

meaning.en: you are always seated at the muladhara, the base of the body
meaning.hi: आप सदा मूलाधार में स्थित हैं

meaning.en: you embody the three powers, will, knowledge, and action
meaning.hi: आप तीनों शक्तियों के स्वरूप हैं

meaning.en: yogis meditate on you constantly
meaning.hi: योगीजन नित्य आपका ध्यान करते हैं

words.sanskrit: tvam brahma tvam vishnus tvam rudras tvamindras

meaning.en: you are Brahma, you are Vishnu, you are Rudra, you are Indra
meaning.hi: आप ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, रुद्र और इंद्र हैं

words.sanskrit: tvamagnis tvam vayus tvam suryas tvam chandrama

meaning.en: you are Agni, you are Vayu, you are Surya, you are Chandra
meaning.hi: आप अग्नि, वायु, सूर्य और चंद्रमा हैं

meaning.en: you are Brahman, and the earth, mid-space, and heavens held in Om
meaning.hi: आप ब्रह्म हैं, और ॐ में समाए भूः भुवः स्वः हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: first pronounce the sound Ga
then right after it the sound A
the nasal hum comes next, placed above
adorned with a crescent-moon mark
deepened with the resonant high tone
this is your own mantra form
the sound Ga is the first part
the sound A is the middle part
the nasal hum is the closing part
the dot above is the highest part
this is the mantra known as Ganesha Vidya
its sage is Ganaka
its meter is Nichrid Gayatri
its deity is the great Ganapati
Om, salutations to Ganapati, called by the sound Gam

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: we come to know the one with a single tusk
we hold in thought the one with a curved trunk
may that tusked one guide and set our understanding in motion
meaning.hi: वह दंती हमारी बुद्धि को प्रेरित करें

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one tusk, four arms
holding a noose and a goad
meaning.hi: पाश और अंकुश धारण करने वाले

meaning.en: holding the broken tusk, and offering blessing with the other hands
meaning.hi: टूटा दाँत लिए और वरदान देते हुए

meaning.en: with the mouse on his banner
red, large-bellied, wide-eared like a winnowing fan, wearing red cloth
body smeared with red sandal paste, worshipped with red flowers
meaning.hi: लाल चंदन-लिप्त, लाल फूलों से पूजित

meaning.en: the god kind to devotees, the never-failing cause of the universe
meaning.hi: भक्तों पर करुणा करने वाले, जगत के अच्युत कारण

meaning.en: present at the very start of creation, beyond nature and the individual spirit
meaning.hi: सृष्टि के आरंभ में प्रकट, प्रकृति-पुरुष से परे

words.sanskrit: evam dhyayati yo nityam sa yogi yoginam varah

meaning.en: whoever meditates on this daily becomes the finest among yogis
meaning.hi: जो नित्य ऐसा ध्यान करता है वह योगियों में श्रेष्ठ है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: salutations to the lord of every gathered group
salutations to Ganapati
salutations to the lord who leads the attendant spirits
salutations to you
to the large-bellied one, the one-tusked one
to the destroyer of obstacles
to the son of Shiva
to the one whose form itself grants blessing, salutations

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever studies this Atharvashirsha
meaning.hi: जो इस अथर्वशीर्ष का अध्ययन करता है

meaning.en: becomes fit to reach the state of Brahman
meaning.hi: वह ब्रह्मभाव के योग्य बनता है

meaning.en: no obstacle can hold that person back
meaning.hi: वह सर्व विघ्नों से बाधित नहीं होता

meaning.en: that person prospers happily in every direction
freed from the five gravest wrongs
meaning.hi: पाँच महापापों से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: reciting it in the evening wipes away the day's wrongdoing
meaning.hi: शाम को पढ़ने से दिन का पाप नष्ट होता है

meaning.en: reciting it in the morning wipes away the night's wrongdoing
meaning.hi: सुबह पढ़ने से रात का पाप नष्ट होता है

meaning.en: attains right living, prosperity, desire fulfilled, and liberation
meaning.hi: धर्म, अर्थ, काम और मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है

meaning.en: this Atharvashirsha should not be given to an unfit person
meaning.hi: यह अथर्वशीर्ष अयोग्य को न दें

words.sanskrit: sahasravartanadyam yam kamamadhite tam tamanena sadhayet

meaning.en: reciting it a thousand times, one accomplishes whatever was desired
meaning.hi: सहस्र बार पढ़ने से इच्छित सिद्धि मिलती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever bathes an image of Ganapati while reciting this
meaning.hi: इससे गणपति का अभिषेक करने वाला

meaning.en: becomes a gifted speaker
fasting on the fourth lunar day and quietly repeating it
meaning.hi: चतुर्थी के दिन उपवास रखकर जप करने वाला

meaning.en: becomes deeply learned
this is the declaration of the Atharva tradition
whoever lives by this knowledge never fears losing it
meaning.hi: जो इस विद्या का आचरण करता है वह कभी नहीं डरता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever worships with fresh durva grass shoots
meaning.hi: जो दूर्वा-अंकुरों से पूजा करता है

meaning.en: becomes as prosperous as the guardian of wealth
meaning.hi: वह कुबेर के समान बनता है

meaning.en: whoever worships with roasted grains
meaning.hi: जो लाजा से पूजा करता है

words.sanskrit: sa yashovan bhavati sa medhavan bhavati

meaning.en: becomes famous and sharp-minded
meaning.hi: वह यशस्वी और मेधावी बनता है

meaning.en: whoever worships with a thousand modakas obtains what they hoped for
meaning.hi: जो हज़ार मोदकों से पूजा करता है वह इच्छित फल पाता है

words.sanskrit: yah sajya samidbhiryajati sa sarvam labhate sa sarvam labhate

meaning.en: whoever offers ghee and sacred wood in fire receives everything
meaning.hi: जो घी और समिधा से यज्ञ करता है वह सब कुछ पाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: properly teaching this to eight learned scholars
becomes as radiant as the sun
meaning.hi: सूर्य के समान तेजस्वी बनता है

meaning.en: reciting during a solar eclipse, by a great river, or near a sacred image
meaning.hi: सूर्यग्रहण में, महानदी में या मूर्ति के पास जप करने से

meaning.en: it becomes a fully realized mantra
meaning.hi: यह सिद्ध मंत्र बन जाता है

meaning.en: freed from great obstacles, freed from serious faults
meaning.hi: महाविघ्न और महादोष से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: freed from grave wrongdoing, freed from every calamity
meaning.hi: महापाप और महाप्रत्यवाय से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: that person truly comes to know all things
this is what one who understands this teaching comes to know; so concludes this Upanishad
meaning.hi: जो यह जानता है, वह जानता है। इति उपनिषद्
